blocks.text: Begin preparing for the summer heat with AC maintenance services in Converse, TX. An AC tune-up keeps your utility bills low and prevents future repairs. Your air conditioner works hard in the summer, so get it ready by scheduling a thorough inspection. Our team at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air can keep your system running smoothly.

Maintaining your air conditioning system is an important part of keeping your home or business comfortable. If you don’t schedule regular maintenance appointments, your air conditioning unit will break down more often.

Inside your AC unit, many parts work together to remove contaminants from the air and cool your home. Without preventative maintenance, these parts can malfunction. Prevent expensive repairs with regular system maintenance.

items: Checking the air filter for clogs and debris

blocks.text: Homeowners often ask us how often they should schedule an AC tune-up. We recommend calling our team at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air to service your air conditioning unit annually. Spring is a great time to schedule that tune-up. As temperatures rise outside, you won’t have to worry about your AC’s operation.

Home and business owners can help maintain their AC unit with a few simple actions. Change your air filters at least once every two months. If you have pets or suffer from allergies, you may need to change your filters more frequently. Remove debris, yard waste, and plants from the area around your air conditioning unit. Clean your vents to keep them free of dust and dirt. These actions can help you prepare your air conditioner for your maintenance appointment.
